summary.text: Drew Peterson is a Republican state representative from District 19 who took office in January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a farmer and rancher.

paragraphs.text: Drew Peterson earned a degree in finance from the University of South Dakota and works as a farmer and rancher, according to Ballotpedia.
He assumed office in the South Dakota House of Representatives on January 10, 2023.
In the 2025-2026 session, Peterson serves on the House Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee and the House Commerce and Energy Committee.
